breakingChanges.title: Project access accepts only email addresses and group names
breakingChanges.affects: Projects whose access[].users hold a value that is not an email address, or whose access[].groups hold a value that is not a group name (capitals, spaces, commas, display names). Also more than 50 access entries, or more than 100 users or groups in one entry.
breakingChanges.impact: Such a Project can be rejected when it is next changed. The invalid values never granted access.
before: In each organisation, list the affected values with the check in the release notes (kubectl get projects -A -o json | jq ...).
Replace each users value with the email address the person signs in with.
Replace each groups value with the group's metadata.name.
after: kubectl get projects -A shows READY True for every project.
Saving a project in the console succeeds without a validation error.

interfaceChanges.summary: Cluster-scoped, single object named cluster. Network isolation and egress rules for platform namespaces.
Manage or read NetworkingConfig. Not bound, not aggregated.
Rejects config.platform.stakater.com objects not named cluster.
Network isolation and egress rule values. Set through NetworkingConfig.
Console select lists for Project role and network mode. Default of serviceCatalogs.project.enabled in this release: TBD.
Email addresses only (optional oidc: prefix). At most 100 items, 254 characters each.
Group names only: ^(oidc:)?[a-z0-9]([-a-z0-9.]*[a-z0-9])?$. At most 100 items, 253 characters each.
Select of project roles with descriptions. The API still accepts any role name.
Select offers udn and native; external only where the platform adds it. The API still accepts all three.
Shown masked, with reveal and copy of the decoded value.
Shown masked, with reveal and copy of the decoded value.
No longer offered in the console. Stays in the API; no effect on access.

features.title: Platform configuration APIs
features.summary: Typed, validated resources in config.platform.stakater.com/v1alpha1 for tuning the platform; the first is NetworkingConfig. Only values you set are applied. First supported component: Forecastle (namespace stakater-forecastle).

features.title: Project form in the console
features.summary: Role and network mode are select lists with descriptions; users and groups explain and validate what to enter.

features.title: Masked initial passwords
features.summary: Initial passwords of users and of the organisation administrator are masked in the console, with reveal and copy. Users change the password at first sign-in.

fixes.summary: On upgrade, the organisation Vault setup job no longer fails and retries when OIDC is already configured. No action required.
members is described as usernames (a user's email address on this platform).

knownIssues.summary: A NetworkingConfig not named cluster is rejected on create; where the name policy is not installed it is accepted but never applied.
NetworkingConfig entries for namespaces no component supports in this release change nothing.
An override EnvironmentConfig for a component takes precedence over NetworkingConfig.
knownIssues.workaround: Remove the network policy values from the override, or set them there.

knownIssues.summary: Editing a Project in the console whose network mode the platform no longer offers shows an empty select.
